title: Percakapan grup WhatsApp soal somasi

images.alt: Tangkapan layar percakapan grup WhatsApp: pesan “terus kenapa kamu somasi si abil? kalau dia bohong, dosa dia.” dan “kamu mau somasi orang2 yang bohong”, dengan satu stiker balasan

shows: Percakapan di sebuah grup WhatsApp. Satu peserta menulis “terus kenapa kamu somasi si abil? kalau dia bohong, dosa dia.” (1:51 PM), lalu “kamu mau somasi orang2 yang bohong” dan “capelah”. Pemilik tangkapan layar membalas dengan stiker.
limits: Hanya pendapat peserta percakapan; tidak ada bukti tentang benar atau tidaknya klaim apa pun pada gambar. Nama dan identitas peserta tidak ditampilkan, nama grup dipotong, isi somasi yang dimaksud tidak terlihat, dan tanggal tidak terlihat.

en.title: WhatsApp group chat about the legal warning
alts: Screenshot of a WhatsApp group chat: the messages "so why did you send a somasi to abil? if he lies, that is his sin." and "you want to send a somasi to people who lie", with one sticker reply
en.shows: A conversation in a WhatsApp group. One participant writes "so why did you send a somasi to abil? if he lies, that is his sin." (1:51 PM), then "you want to send a somasi to people who lie" and "tiring". The owner of the screenshot replies with a sticker.
en.limits: Only the opinions of the chat participants; the image contains no evidence about whether any claim is true or false. The participants' names and identities are not shown, the group name is cut off, the contents of the somasi in question are not visible, and the date is not visible.
